items.title: Pine is an active compiler/runtime/editor dependency
items.evidence: frontends registers Pine; semanticAnalyzer imports Pine builtins; runtime imports Pine math/string/color; languageService imports Pine completions; AST/IR metadata and exports retain Pine.
items.impact: Delete would break production compile/semantic/runtime/editor paths.
items.action: Replace each dependency with native CoreSpirit capabilities before removing Pine.

items.title: Pine strategyEntry contract is failing
items.evidence: PineV6FrontendContract.test.ts:65 asserts Pine strategyEntry compiles to a dedicated simulation-only command.
items.impact: Main CI contract step is red before most tests.
items.action: Triage lowering versus contract expectation; fix and preserve the simulation-only boundary.
items.fixDescription: Namespaced member-call lowering emits the declared builtin emitKind after the call instruction.

items.title: Chart initial bundle exceeds hard gzip limit
items.evidence: Chart static graph 663.0 KB gzip; hard limit 650 KB; optimization target 550 KB.
items.impact: Production build gate fails by 13 KB beyond the hard limit.
items.action: Split heavy chart/editor/model dependencies and optimize real graph contributors; do not raise the budget.

items.title: Authenticated soak cannot sign in
items.evidence: Soak run 46007338048 failed in create-browser-auth-state.mjs with Supabase CI test-account error: Invalid login credentials.
items.action: Repair or rotate dedicated CI account credentials; verify auth bootstrap and rerun full soak.

items.title: Existing registries do not provide the required neutral capability map
items.evidence: capabilityMaturity.ts is a stage-evidence builder; Pine feature registry is vendor-specific; library namespace registry includes catalog-only metadata.
items.action: Use the new vendor-neutral phase-0 capability registry as the controlled audit baseline.

items.title: Pine concepts leak into native parser, AST, IR and semantic analysis
items.evidence: pine frontend mode, Pine declaration metadata, semantic import of Pine builtin registry.; ir.ts imports 18 optional optimizer/planner/compiler-trace/research/policy metadata types.
items.impact: Language evolution and zero-Pine migration remain coupled.
items.action: Introduce neutral declarations and compatibility adapters outside native compiler internals.

items.title: CoreSpirit runtime is a large multi-responsibility module
items.evidence: runtime.ts is 162,858 bytes at audited revision and imports data, state, kernels, output and Pine builtin adapters.
items.impact: Large regression surface across language/runtime changes.
items.action: Split state, data requests, builtin dispatch, orchestration and output services behind stable contracts.

items.title: Large chart/editor composition modules
items.evidence: tcoVelaChrome.ts 262,284 bytes; CoreSpiritEditorPage.tsx 132,405 bytes; NativeRenderer.ts 302,085 bytes (vendored).
items.action: Decompose first-party modules; treat vendor code as a separate upstream/fork ownership decision.

items.title: Algorithm-like prediction catalogue mixes heuristic proxies with trained models
items.evidence: predictionEngine.ts labels many 'ready' entries as research-heuristic and describes them as proxies; production trained-server entries are separately planned.
items.impact: Users may mistake heuristics for trained/calibrated model inference.
items.action: Separate heuristic and trained artifact surfaces; show provenance; require OOS/calibration/drift release gates.

items.title: Execution planner can be mistaken for actual GPU support
items.evidence: executionPlanner.ts states it is a planner, not GPU implementation; backendRegistry requires an actual adapter.
items.impact: Planned backend is not proof that hardware executed work.
items.action: Expose actual backend, adapter version, fallback reason and parity in telemetry.

items.title: Native namespaces and catalog/vendor names share one registry
items.evidence: standardLibraryNamespaces.ts carries native and Pine-derived namespaces and entries with builtin/component/catalog status.
items.impact: Editor discovery can expose unsupported catalog items and native names remain coupled to compatibility.
items.action: Separate native API registry from compatibility fixtures; completions should prefer executable native providers.

items.title: Vercel check reports build-rate-limit failure
items.evidence: Commit combined status target points to Vercel build-rate-limit/blocked deployment.
items.impact: A green code build does not guarantee latest main is deployed.
items.action: Inspect deployment quota/status and verify production alias against the intended green commit.

items.title: CoreSpirit IR schema carries a large compiler/planner/report metadata surface
evidence: src/services/coreSpirit/ir.ts is 111 lines and its CoreSpiritIrProgram optional metadata fields import 18 modules using import type.
Those type dependencies include optimizer, execution planner, compiler pipeline, specialized plans, repaint/causality reports, research surface and language policy.
CoreSpiritPineDeclarationMetadata remains embedded in the IR's shared AST metadata types.
items.impact: These are compile-time rather than demonstrated runtime cycles, but they couple the canonical IR schema to higher-level compilation, planning, inspection and Pine compatibility layers. Artifact schema evolution becomes harder to isolate.
items.action: Split executable IR from derived analysis/inspection metadata. Keep the canonical IR schema dependent only on language-neutral value/instruction contracts; attach optional analysis reports through a versioned artifact envelope or sidecar metadata.

items.title: Artifact-cache dynamic import is defeated by static imports in chart execution owners
evidence: Production Vite warns src/services/coreSpirit/artifactCache.ts is dynamically imported by coreSpiritWorkerPool.ts but statically imported by src/CoreSpiritVelaEngine.ts and src/services/coreSpirit/chartRunner.ts.
Vite explicitly says this dynamic import will not move the module into another chunk.
Chart initial static graph remains 663.0 KB gzip against a 650 KB hard ceiling.
items.impact: The intended lazy boundary does not split artifactCache out of the static chunk graph; chart remains over its hard bundle budget.
items.action: Inspect synchronous cache consumers; move them behind an async cache service or isolate safe metadata. Re-run static-closure budget and browser cold-start benchmarks before merging.

resolvedItems.title: Fail-fast suite hides the remaining contract results
resolvedItems.evidence: 249 contracts are registered; CI stopped on entry 2 after the Pine frontend assertion failed.
resolvedItems.impact: The other entries were not reached and cannot be treated as passed.
resolvedItems.action: Aggregate independent failures and emit structured per-contract results; retain optional fail-fast local mode.
resolvedItems.resolution: The runner aggregates independent failures by default, emits JSON results, removes duplicates and includes all 82 CoreSpirit test files. The primary suite has 258 unique test files.

resolvedItems.title: 11 CoreSpirit test files absent from the primary contract runner
resolvedItems.impact: These tests are not run by npm run test:contracts.
resolvedItems.action: Assign each test to a suite and CI step; avoid ambiguous manual-only tests.
